mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the cost of capital and stimulates equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment and reduce corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5% for 3 consecutive months, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in residential construction starts (HOUST) below 500,000 units combined with a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) below 330,000 million dollars signals a collapse in private demand, which depresses corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both HOUST < 500.0 and RSAFS < 330000.0, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening economic activity and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during INDPRO < 90.0 for 2 consecutive months, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 340,000 million dollars combined with a rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 530,000 units signals a recovery in private demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both RSAFS > 340000.0 and HOUST > 530.0, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% for three consecutive months signals a loss of central bank credibility and triggers expectations of future rate hikes, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during CPIAUCSL > 3.0 for 3 consecutive months, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 130,000 thousand and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 9.5% signals a labor market breakdown, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS < 130000.0 and UNRATE > 9.5, or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rebound in real GDP (GDPC1) above 1.5% annualized growth for two consecutive quarters signals strong economic momentum, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during GDPC1 > 1.5% annualized for 2 consecutive quarters, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
